page_evidence.compact_facts:
[chunk-1] RWKV的创始人是Peng Bo。 RWKV发布了其第一个模型（于2022年底发布）。 RWKV的GitHub项目链接是https://github.com/BlinkDL/RWKV-LM。
[chunk-2] RWKV is an RNN-based architecture that combines the efficient parallel training of the Transformer with the efficient reasoning ability of the RNN. RWKV was created by Peng Bo. RWKV has released models from 0.1B to 14B parameters, with a 32B preview model released by the overseas community. RWKV-7 is the latest version, which comprehensively surpasses the Transformer architecture under the same parameter scale. RWKV-7 has a stronger memory than previous versions, e.g., a 0.1B model trained in a 4k context window can solve a 16k needle-in-a-haystack problem. RWKV-7 enables continuous learning during inference, allowing the model to learn patterns in previous text.
[chunk-3] RWKV的创始人是Luo Xuan RWKV-LM项目在GitHub上获得了超过12,900星 RWKV-7版本支持边缘设备部署 RWKV-7计划在2025年发布参数超过70B的版本
